description: This file defines the TermStorage class for managing taxonomy term entities in Drupal, including methods for loading, caching, and retrieving hierarchical term data.

classes.name: TermStorage
classes.description: A class extending SqlContentEntityStorage to handle taxonomy term storage with hierarchical data management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new taxonomy term entity, defaulting parent to 0 if not specified.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Resets internal caches related to term hierarchy and ancestors.

methods.name: loadParents
methods.description: Loads parent terms of a given term ID.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Returns parent terms of a given term, including handling for root parent.

methods.name: loadAllParents
methods.description: Loads all ancestor terms of a given term ID.

methods.name: getAncestors
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all ancestors of a term, with caching.

methods.name: loadChildren
methods.description: Loads child terms of a given term ID.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns child terms of a given term.

methods.name: loadTree
methods.description: Loads a hierarchical tree of terms for a vocabulary, with caching.

methods.name: nodeCount
methods.description: Counts the number of nodes associated with a vocabulary ID.

methods.name: resetWeights
methods.description: Resets weights of terms in a vocabulary.

methods.name: getNodeTerms
methods.description: Retrieves terms associated with specific node IDs.

methods.name: getTermIdsWithPendingRevisions
methods.description: Gets IDs of terms with pending revisions.

methods.name: getVocabularyHierarchyType
methods.description: Determines the hierarchy type (disabled, single, multiple) for a vocabulary.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares object for serialization, excluding caches.
